row.title: PR-BOUND-3: a bound is timed from when its condition began, not from when the pull request opened
row.body: PR-BOUND-2 closed a labelled pull request by minutes since it opened, so any pull request open past 30 minutes was closed on the first lane pass that saw a conflict. #2686 was closed 17 seconds after main moved under it, with the reason 'unresolved for 90 min'; #2664 and #2615 went the same way. The age is now minutes since the label was last put on, read from the issue events; the lane adds the label once per episode and removes it when the condition clears. A label time that cannot be read is unmeasured and closes nothing. A timer on a condition must start when the condition starts.

title: PR-BOUND-3: a bound is timed from when its condition began, not from when the pull request opened
